breakpoints.code: return mrb_load_exec(mrb, mrb_parse_file_continue(mrb, fp, leading.b, bufsize, c), c);

breakpoints.note: First project statement on the witnessed path that materializes vulnerability-relevant attacker input into the C variables later passed to `mrb_ary_splice`. For the staged source `[2][0,7]=[]`, it extracts the two integer operands `0` and `7` plus the empty replacement array `[]` from the Ruby call.

Root cause fixed by the patch. When the requested slice extends past the array end, this block clamps `len` but leaves `tail` at its earlier value `head + original_len`; the fix adds `tail = head + len` here so later move arithmetic uses the clamped endpoint.
